info.title: stellarlens api
info.description: Index and query Soroban contract events and token transfers. This file is the source of truth for the generated `@stellarlens/sdk` types — after editing it, run `pnpm --filter @stellarlens/sdk generate`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `nextCursor`).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the contract name.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

post.summary: Register a new contract. Existing addresses return 409 without mutation; use PATCH to update a registered contract.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

409.description: A contract with this address is already registered. The response includes its existing id.

post.summary: Register up to 100 contracts, reporting a result per item.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.
Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

patch.summary: Update a contract's name and/or network.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

get.summary: Cursor-paginated events for a contract, oldest first by default.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `nextCursor`).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` pages oldest-first (`cursor` returns larger ids); `desc` pages newest-first (`cursor` returns smaller ids). `order=desc&limit=1` returns the latest event.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Only events whose decoded topic contains this value.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Only events whose decoded topic contains any of these values (comma-separated or repeated).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only events indexed at or after this ISO 8601 time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only events indexed at or before this ISO 8601 time.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

get.summary: Cursor-paginated token transfers for a contract, oldest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `nextCursor`).

parameters.name: minAmount
parameters.description: Only transfers of at least this many base units.

parameters.name: maxAmount
parameters.description: Only transfers of at most this many base units.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only transfers sent by this address.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only transfers received by this address.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

get.summary: Transfer summary stats, optionally scoped to a time window.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.
Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

post.summary: Register a webhook for a contract.

201.description: The webhook, including its signing secret.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

409.description: A webhook is already registered for that url on this contract.

patch.summary: Update a webhook's url and/or event types.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

409.description: Another webhook is already registered for that url on this contract.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return deliveries with an id below this (the previous page's `nextCursor`).

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

201.description: The webhook with its new secret.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

200.description: The api keys (never the raw key).

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

201.description: The new key, including the raw key value.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.
Missing, invalid, revoked or expired api key.

ApiError.description: The error envelope returned by every endpoint.

address.description: Stellar strkey (C... contract or G... account).
Stellar strkey (C... contract or G... account).

ContractPage.description: A page of contracts, ordered by id ascending.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

EventPage.description: A page of events, ordered by id in the requested `order`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

amount.description: Amount in the token's base units, as a decimal string (i128 — don't convert with Number).

rpcEventId.description: Soroban RPC event id that produced this transfer.

TransferPage.description: A page of token transfers, ordered by id ascending.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

volume.description: Summed amount in base units, as a decimal string.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiry; omit for a key that never expires.

key.description: The raw api key. Only returned once, at creation.

eventTypes.description: Event topics to deliver; omit or leave empty for all.

Webhook.description: A webhook including its signing secret (returned on creation and secret rotation).

WebhookDeliveryPage.description: A page of deliveries, newest first (`cursor` returns deliveries with a smaller id).

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.
